create or replace function studymeta_api.get_my_active_learning_session()
returns setof jsonb language sql security definer set search_path = pg_catalog as $$
  select studymeta_v2.pilot_session_json(s,l)
  from studymeta_v2.sessions s join studymeta_v2.pilot_session_plans l
    on l.learner_id=s.learner_id and l.session_id=s.id
  where s.learner_id=studymeta_v2.current_learner_id() and s.status in ('active','idle')
  order by s.started_at desc limit 1
$$;

nodes.codeExcerpt:
create or replace function studymeta_api.list_my_session_reviews_for_plan(p_plan_id uuid default null)
returns setof jsonb language sql security definer set search_path = pg_catalog as $$
  select jsonb_build_object('summary_id',r.id,'session_id',r.session_id,'plan_id',link.plan_id,
    'strong_points',r.strong_points,'difficult_points',r.difficult_points,'review_points',r.review_points,
    'next_step',r.next_step,'created_at',r.created_at,'saved',true)
  from studymeta_v2.pilot_session_reviews r
  join studymeta_v2.pilot_session_plans link on link.learner_id=r.learner_id and link.session_id=r.session_id
  where r.learner_id=studymeta_v2.current_learner_id() and (p_plan_id is null or link.plan_id=p_plan_id)
  order by r.created_at desc
$$;

nodes.title: studymeta_api.get_my_learning_insights
nodes.codeExcerpt:
create or replace function studymeta_api.get_my_learning_insights(p_plan_id uuid default null,p_session_id uuid default null)
returns setof jsonb language sql security definer set search_path = pg_catalog as $$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'session_id',event.session_id,'plan_id',event.plan_id,'plan_title',coalesce(plan.title,'자유 학습'),
    'concept_node_id',event.concept_node_id,
    'concept_label',coalesce((select node->>'label' from jsonb_array_elements(plan.nodes) node where node->>'node_id'=event.concept_node_id limit 1),coalesce(event.concept_node_id,'자유 학습')),
    'event_type',event.event_type,
    'observed_behavior',coalesce(nullif(event.observation->>'learner_text_excerpt',''),nullif(event.observation->>'result_basis',''),
      case event.event_type when 'attempt_submitted' then '문제 풀이를 제출했어요.' when 'self_report' then '학습 상태를 직접 말했어요.' when 'question' then '질문했어요.' else '학습 행동이 관찰됐어요.' end),
    'evidence_labels',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(case evidence.evidence_type
      when 'correct' then '정답 확인' when 'incorrect' then '오답 확인' when 'partial_success' then '부분 성공'
      when 'hint_requested' then '힌트 요청' when 'self_correction' then '스스로 수정' when 'confidence_report' then '자신감 표현'
      else '추가 학습 근거' end order by evidence.created_at)
      from studymeta_v2.pilot_evidence_observations evidence
      where evidence.learner_id=event.learner_id and evidence.event_id=event.id),'[]'::jsonb),
    'state_summaries',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(summary order by candidate.created_at) from (
      select candidate.*,case candidate.state_type
        when 'conceptual_mastery' then '개념 이해 후보' when 'procedural_mastery' then '풀이 수행 후보' else '도움 필요도 후보' end
        || ' ' || round(candidate.value*100)::text || '% · 추정 신뢰도 ' || round(candidate.estimate_confidence*100)::text || '%' as summary
      from studymeta_v2.pilot_state_candidates candidate
      where candidate.learner_id=event.learner_id and candidate.plan_id=event.plan_id
        and candidate.concept_node_id=event.concept_node_id and exists(select 1 from studymeta_v2.pilot_evidence_observations e where e.learner_id=event.learner_id and e.event_id=event.id and e.id=any(candidate.evidence_ids))
    ) candidate),'[]'::jsonb),
    'occurred_at',event.occurred_at)
  from studymeta_v2.pilot_learning_events event
  left join studymeta_v2.study_plans plan on plan.learner_id=event.learner_id and plan.id=event.plan_id
  where event.learner_id=studymeta_v2.current_learner_id()
    and (p_plan_id is null or event.plan_id=p_plan_id)
    and (p_session_id is null or event.session_id=p_session_id)
  order by event.occurred_at desc limit 100
$$;

nodes.title: studymeta_api.get_my_pilot_state_candidates
nodes.codeExcerpt:
create or replace function studymeta_api.get_my_pilot_state_candidates()
returns setof jsonb language sql security definer set search_path = pg_catalog as $$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'plan_id',latest.plan_id,'plan_title',plan.title,'concept_node_id',latest.concept_node_id,
    'concept_label',coalesce((select node->>'label' from jsonb_array_elements(plan.nodes) node where node->>'node_id'=latest.concept_node_id limit 1),latest.concept_node_id),
    'state_type',latest.state_type,'value',latest.value,'estimate_confidence',latest.estimate_confidence,
    'status',latest.status,'validation_status',latest.validation_status,'created_at',latest.created_at)
  from (
    select distinct on(c.plan_id,c.concept_node_id,c.state_type) c.*
    from studymeta_v2.pilot_state_candidates c where c.learner_id=studymeta_v2.current_learner_id()
    order by c.plan_id,c.concept_node_id,c.state_type,c.created_at desc
  ) latest join studymeta_v2.study_plans plan on plan.learner_id=latest.learner_id and plan.id=latest.plan_id
  order by latest.created_at desc
$$;
